meta.title: Swift Trailblaze
meta.description: Where the divine light cannot shine, danger lurks, and chaos burgeons.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth, near Energy Tower No. 4.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth, near Energy Tower No. 4.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth, near Energy Tower No. 4.

units.rawText: With a flick of the wrist, Electra casually casts off the purple ichor coating her knives.
units.displayText: With a flick of the wrist, Electra casually casts off the purple ichor coating her knives.

spans.text: With a flick of the wrist, Electra casually casts off the purple ichor coating her knives.

units.rawText: Was that the 21st... or the 22nd one? I've lost count...
units.displayText: Was that the 21st... or the 22nd one? I've lost count...

spans.text: Was that the 21st... or the 22nd one? I've lost count...

units.rawText: Don't let your guard down, Electra.
units.displayText: Don't let your guard down, Electra.

spans.text: Don't let your guard down, Electra.

units.rawText: A golden arrow pierces the Low-Order Entropic behind her.
units.displayText: A golden arrow pierces the Low-Order Entropic behind her.

spans.text: A golden arrow pierces the Low-Order Entropic behind her.

units.rawText: Teehee, I can always relax as long as you're watching my back, Ally.
units.displayText: Teehee, I can always relax as long as you're watching my back, Ally.

spans.text: Teehee, I can always relax as long as you're watching my back, Ally.

units.rawText: I could never find you during training. If you keep acting like this, I'll ask Lord Eosphorus to revoke your authority and no amount of pleading from Atlas will help you!
units.displayText: I could never find you during training. If you keep acting like this, I'll ask Lord Eosphorus to revoke your authority and no amount of pleading from Atlas will help you!

spans.text: I could never find you during training. If you keep acting like this, I'll ask Lord Eosphorus to revoke your authority and no amount of pleading from Atlas will help you!

units.rawText: Aw, don't be so harsh, Ally~
units.displayText: Aw, don't be so harsh, Ally~

spans.text: Aw, don't be so harsh, Ally~

units.rawText: Despite their banter, their movements are as careful and measured as ever.
units.displayText: Despite their banter, their movements are as careful and measured as ever.

spans.text: Despite their banter, their movements are as careful and measured as ever.

units.rawText: Electra throws one of the knives she's holding and impales a struggling Entropic to the ground near Alcyone's feet.
units.displayText: Electra throws one of the knives she's holding and impales a struggling Entropic to the ground near Alcyone's feet.

spans.text: Electra throws one of the knives she's holding and impales a struggling Entropic to the ground near Alcyone's feet.

units.rawText: Still... Don't you think there's something wrong about the number of Entropics, Ally?
units.displayText: Still... Don't you think there's something wrong about the number of Entropics, Ally?

spans.text: Still... Don't you think there's something wrong about the number of Entropics, Ally?

units.rawText: Yeah. The Entropic density around the energy tower is growing. More and more Entropics are gathering here. Fortunately, they haven't spotted us yet.
units.displayText: Yeah. The Entropic density around the energy tower is growing. More and more Entropics are gathering here. Fortunately, they haven't spotted us yet.

spans.text: Yeah. The Entropic density around the energy tower is growing. More and more Entropics are gathering here. Fortunately, they haven't spotted us yet.

units.rawText: There are at least 20% more Entropics here than when we began sneaking in. If we factor in the ones we killed on the way here...
units.displayText: There are at least 20% more Entropics here than when we began sneaking in. If we factor in the ones we killed on the way here...

spans.text: There are at least 20% more Entropics here than when we began sneaking in. If we factor in the ones we killed on the way here...

units.rawText: Electra looks around. Various types of Entropics writhe and mill around the base of the tower like a sea of purple.
units.displayText: Electra looks around. Various types of Entropics writhe and mill around the base of the tower like a sea of purple.

spans.text: Electra looks around. Various types of Entropics writhe and mill around the base of the tower like a sea of purple.

units.rawText: Ally, things here are just too weird. Let's just retreat for now, okay?
units.displayText: Ally, things here are just too weird. Let's just retreat for now, okay?

spans.text: Ally, things here are just too weird. Let's just retreat for now, okay?

units.rawText: We're almost at the energy tower. How can we give up halfway?
units.displayText: We're almost at the energy tower. How can we give up halfway?

spans.text: We're almost at the energy tower. How can we give up halfway?

units.rawText: Alcyone drags Electra along with her as she winds her way through the Entropic hordes, toward the core of the energy tower.
units.displayText: Alcyone drags Electra along with her as she winds her way through the Entropic hordes, toward the core of the energy tower.

spans.text: Alcyone drags Electra along with her as she winds her way through the Entropic hordes, toward the core of the energy tower.

units.rawText: The fact that there are so many Entropics here means that our diversionary attacks were effective. The Entropics have realized that we're targeting the energy towers and they're protecting the places that are most important to them.
units.displayText: The fact that there are so many Entropics here means that our diversionary attacks were effective. The Entropics have realized that we're targeting the energy towers and they're protecting the places that are most important to them.

spans.text: The fact that there are so many Entropics here means that our diversionary attacks were effective. The Entropics have realized that we're targeting the energy towers and they're protecting the places that are most important to them.

units.rawText: Our decision just now was correct. If we can damage the main energy tower, we might even be able to ease the pressure on the border units...
units.displayText: Our decision just now was correct. If we can damage the main energy tower, we might even be able to ease the pressure on the border units...

spans.text: Our decision just now was correct. If we can damage the main energy tower, we might even be able to ease the pressure on the border units...

units.rawText: That's only if we can leave here safely. Eos said as much; we need to get into the Middle Ring in one piece...
units.displayText: That's only if we can leave here safely. Eos said as much; we need to get into the Middle Ring in one piece...

spans.text: That's only if we can leave here safely. Eos said as much; we need to get into the Middle Ring in one piece...

units.rawText: Relax, Electra. All the Entropics we've destroyed on the way here were for the sake of clearing a route of retreat.
units.displayText: Relax, Electra. All the Entropics we've destroyed on the way here were for the sake of clearing a route of retreat.

spans.text: Relax, Electra. All the Entropics we've destroyed on the way here were for the sake of clearing a route of retreat.

units.rawText: Alcyone suddenly stops in her tracks and looks up toward the core, shining high above them. Purple operands flow within it and power wells up from it.
units.displayText: Alcyone suddenly stops in her tracks and looks up toward the core, shining high above them. Purple operands flow within it and power wells up from it.

spans.text: Alcyone suddenly stops in her tracks and looks up toward the core, shining high above them. Purple operands flow within it and power wells up from it.

units.rawText: This range... should be enough.
units.displayText: This range... should be enough.

spans.text: This range... should be enough.

units.rawText: ...Ally?
units.displayText: ...Ally?

spans.text: ...Ally?

units.rawText: Alcyone crouches down to conceal herself and lowers her processing speed. Her eyes do not leave the energy tower for a moment while she's whispering to Electra.
units.displayText: Alcyone crouches down to conceal herself and lowers her processing speed. Her eyes do not leave the energy tower for a moment while she's whispering to Electra.

spans.text: Alcyone crouches down to conceal herself and lowers her processing speed. Her eyes do not leave the energy tower for a moment while she's whispering to Electra.

units.rawText: Trust me, Electra. I've made all the preparations I could, and according to my calculations, the success rate of this operation is estimated to be... 73%.
units.displayText: Trust me, Electra. I've made all the preparations I could, and according to my calculations, the success rate of this operation is estimated to be... 73%.

spans.text: Trust me, Electra. I've made all the preparations I could, and according to my calculations, the success rate of this operation is estimated to be... 73%.

units.rawText: You can make up for the remaining 27%.
units.displayText: You can make up for the remaining 27%.

spans.text: You can make up for the remaining 27%.

units.rawText: I hope that you can trust me the way you trust Lord Eosphorus and Atlas.
units.displayText: I hope that you can trust me the way you trust Lord Eosphorus and Atlas.

spans.text: I hope that you can trust me the way you trust Lord Eosphorus and Atlas.

units.rawText: Ally...
units.displayText: Ally...

spans.text: Ally...

units.rawText: Electra looks at the profile of Alcyone's face. The determined look in her eyes suddenly seems a little unfamiliar to her.
units.displayText: Electra looks at the profile of Alcyone's face. The determined look in her eyes suddenly seems a little unfamiliar to her.

spans.text: Electra looks at the profile of Alcyone's face. The determined look in her eyes suddenly seems a little unfamiliar to her.

units.rawText: Ally... You really have grown.
units.displayText: Ally... You really have grown.

spans.text: Ally... You really have grown.

units.rawText: It's been decades since I was born, after all.
units.displayText: It's been decades since I was born, after all.

spans.text: It's been decades since I was born, after all.

units.rawText: That long, huh... Looks like Atlas and I can relax and slack off now.
units.displayText: That long, huh... Looks like Atlas and I can relax and slack off now.

spans.text: That long, huh... Looks like Atlas and I can relax and slack off now.

units.rawText: It's really not a good time to start—
units.displayText: It's really not a good time to start—

spans.text: It's really not a good time to start—

units.rawText: Before Alcyone can finish speaking, a surge of uneasiness washes over the two of them, making them freeze up. An inauspicious ripple explodes from the depths of Tartarus, engulfing the tower in an instant.
units.displayText: Before Alcyone can finish speaking, a surge of uneasiness washes over the two of them, making them freeze up. An inauspicious ripple explodes from the depths of Tartarus, engulfing the tower in an instant.

spans.text: Before Alcyone can finish speaking, a surge of uneasiness washes over the two of them, making them freeze up. An inauspicious ripple explodes from the depths of Tartarus, engulfing the tower in an instant.

units.rawText: This inexplicable uneasiness wells up from their logical base layers, from their system blocks, from the very interstices of their data.
units.displayText: This inexplicable uneasiness wells up from their logical base layers, from their system blocks, from the very interstices of their data.

spans.text: This inexplicable uneasiness wells up from their logical base layers, from their system blocks, from the very interstices of their data.

units.rawText: Alcyone, pull back!
units.displayText: Alcyone, pull back!

spans.text: Alcyone, pull back!

units.rawText: Electra draws her knives and instinctively moves in front of Alcyone, who reflexively draws her bow.
units.displayText: Electra draws her knives and instinctively moves in front of Alcyone, who reflexively draws her bow.

spans.text: Electra draws her knives and instinctively moves in front of Alcyone, who reflexively draws her bow.

units.rawText: (Rumble)
units.displayText: (Rumble)

spans.text: (Rumble)

units.rawText: There is a familiar crash and the walls around the energy tower shift again as the Entropics around them stir and churn.
units.displayText: There is a familiar crash and the walls around the energy tower shift again as the Entropics around them stir and churn.

spans.text: There is a familiar crash and the walls around the energy tower shift again as the Entropics around them stir and churn.

units.rawText: What on earth happened just now...
units.displayText: What on earth happened just now...

spans.text: What on earth happened just now...

units.rawText: The labyrinth shifted in a different way from normal just now... Why did it have to happen at a time like this...
units.displayText: The labyrinth shifted in a different way from normal just now... Why did it have to happen at a time like this...

spans.text: The labyrinth shifted in a different way from normal just now... Why did it have to happen at a time like this...

units.rawText: Wait a minute, a time like this... Was it because <cmdr> and Atlas managed to obtain the Rubik's Map? Was that what caused the labyrinth to shift?
units.displayText: Wait a minute, a time like this... Was it because {교수} and Atlas managed to obtain the Rubik's Map? Was that what caused the labyrinth to shift?

spans.text: Wait a minute, a time like this... Was it because
and Atlas managed to obtain the Rubik's Map? Was that what caused the labyrinth to shift?

units.rawText: Ah, you're so smart, Ally! Our way back is secured now that we have the map.
units.displayText: Ah, you're so smart, Ally! Our way back is secured now that we have the map.

spans.text: Ah, you're so smart, Ally! Our way back is secured now that we have the map.

units.rawText: Let's call them up while the terrain is shifting and the Entropics are distracted.
units.displayText: Let's call them up while the terrain is shifting and the Entropics are distracted.

spans.text: Let's call them up while the terrain is shifting and the Entropics are distracted.

units.rawText: Right. I want to see how much the terrain has changed too. If it didn't affect the plan too much, we might be able to take advantage of the confusion...
units.displayText: Right. I want to see how much the terrain has changed too. If it didn't affect the plan too much, we might be able to take advantage of the confusion...

spans.text: Right. I want to see how much the terrain has changed too. If it didn't affect the plan too much, we might be able to take advantage of the confusion...

units.rawText: Ally opens her terminal and the terrain scan on the monitor shows that the surrounding geography is dramatically different from before.
units.displayText: Ally opens her terminal and the terrain scan on the monitor shows that the surrounding geography is dramatically different from before.

spans.text: Ally opens her terminal and the terrain scan on the monitor shows that the surrounding geography is dramatically different from before.

units.rawText: ...Not good, we can't launch the attack from here. Electra, prepare to reposition...
units.displayText: ...Not good, we can't launch the attack from here. Electra, prepare to reposition...

spans.text: ...Not good, we can't launch the attack from here. Electra, prepare to reposition...

units.rawText: ...Electra?
units.displayText: ...Electra?

spans.text: ...Electra?

units.rawText: Dootdootdoot— Beep—
units.displayText: Dootdootdoot— Beep—

spans.text: Dootdootdoot— Beep—

units.rawText: The only response to Alcyone is the sound of a terminated transmission.
units.displayText: The only response to Alcyone is the sound of a terminated transmission.

spans.text: The only response to Alcyone is the sound of a terminated transmission.

units.rawText: Our comms have been jammed. Something's not right! Electra, we... Electra? What are you looking at?
units.displayText: Our comms have been jammed. Something's not right! Electra, we... Electra? What are you looking at?

spans.text: Our comms have been jammed. Something's not right! Electra, we... Electra? What are you looking at?

units.rawText: Shhh...
units.displayText: Shhh...

spans.text: Shhh...

units.rawText: Alcyone follows Electra's gaze. The Entropic hordes from just now have stopped moving, like an army of silent statues.
units.displayText: Alcyone follows Electra's gaze. The Entropic hordes from just now have stopped moving, like an army of silent statues.

spans.text: Alcyone follows Electra's gaze. The Entropic hordes from just now have stopped moving, like an army of silent statues.

units.rawText: They seem to be waiting for something. The only sound in the air is the cacophony of the Shifting Labyrinth as it changes its layout.
units.displayText: They seem to be waiting for something. The only sound in the air is the cacophony of the Shifting Labyrinth as it changes its layout.

spans.text: They seem to be waiting for something. The only sound in the air is the cacophony of the Shifting Labyrinth as it changes its layout.

units.rawText: Ally, we'd better prepare to retreat...
units.displayText: Ally, we'd better prepare to retreat...

spans.text: Ally, we'd better prepare to retreat...

units.rawText: ...Got it, the Spoof Code's still working so let's sneak out of here! Don't alert...
units.displayText: ...Got it, the Spoof Code's still working so let's sneak out of here! Don't alert...

spans.text: ...Got it, the Spoof Code's still working so let's sneak out of here! Don't alert...

units.rawText: The walls suddenly stop moving, and the entire area goes silent.
units.displayText: The walls suddenly stop moving, and the entire area goes silent.

spans.text: The walls suddenly stop moving, and the entire area goes silent.

units.rawText: At that very moment, all the Entropics move in unison. Countless eyeball-like objects simultaneously turn to look at the two of them—
units.displayText: At that very moment, all the Entropics move in unison. Countless eyeball-like objects simultaneously turn to look at the two of them—

spans.text: At that very moment, all the Entropics move in unison. Countless eyeball-like objects simultaneously turn to look at the two of them—

units.displayText: Warning: Spoof Code 100% ablated! Spoofing failed!
